CheckTitle: VPN connections do not use weak encryption algorithms
Description: Ensure that VPN connections do not use weak encryption algorithms (DES, 3DES) in IKE or IPSec policies.
Risk: Weak encryption algorithms like DES and 3DES are vulnerable to brute-force attacks and do not provide adequate data protection. Using them compromises the confidentiality and integrity of VPN traffic.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Virtual Private Network.
3. Identify VPN connections using DES or 3DES encryption.
4. Update the IKE and IPSec policies to use AES-128 or AES-256.

Recommendation.Text: Change VPN connection encryption algorithms from DES/3DES to AES-128 or AES-256.

Notes: Checks IKE and IPSec encryption algorithms for DES and 3DES.
